about: Numeric sound-quality targets and KNOWN_GAP ratchet values (docs/11 E59).
A setting is a list of `flubsound-cli quality` chain options. A row names a metric of that command's --json
output (a dotted path into the `quality` object, array elements by index), the comparison its target needs,
and optionally the latency profile(s) and hygiene sample rate(s) it is measured at; `byProfile` overrides the
target value per profile. A row with `recorded` values is a KNOWN_GAP: it must not get worse than the value
recorded for the compiler that runs it (gcc, clang, appleclang, msvc) by more than `margin`; without a value
for that compiler the reference (gcc) value is used with twice the margin. A row without `recorded` must meet
its target. When a fix meets a gap row's target, drop `recorded` (the row then guards the target).
tier per-pr: evaluated by tests/test_cli_quality.cpp (fast, every build). tier nightly: only by
tools/scripts/quality-report.py (the full profile x rate matrix, also for tuning sessions).

maximizer-12.about: the maximizer alone at 12 dB drive (every other module off)

music-all-100.about: Music, Boost 100 and every macro at 100

max-drive-24.about: default chain at 24 dB maximizer drive
